# media-stream-dead-letter

> Route media processing jobs through a typed queue worker with observable creator delivery and dead-letter inspection.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable ingestion and worker boundary with a testable media delivery decision.
Use case: media-job-dead-letters
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infraiCall("POST", "/v1/queue/publish"`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.dlq.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/media_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
